review.rationale: WEB.40 successor of web-40-admission-r9 for unit U5, the React removal. apps/site, apps/app and packages/ui are removed with their Vite, React Router, Tailwind and Playwright tooling. The root package.json keeps only wrangler and the TypeScript Worker toolchain (typescript, @types/node). The Contracts npm packages @arcforges/api-client and @arcforges/proto are retired: the Contracts identity is the NuGet ArcForges.Contracts.PublicApi 1.0.0-ci.287.1 publication record (eng/contracts, CON.07), and the naming authority is a byte copy of the NuGet ArcForges.Contracts.Validation 1.0.0-ci.287.1 tools/naming assets (eng/naming, digests pinned in eng/policy/naming-candidate.json). The npm closure is 114 registry entries; the surviving entries are unchanged from the lock of web-40-admission-r9 and the prerelease admissions are the exact versions already reviewed (miniflare, unenv, youch).
review.runtimeAssessment: The deployed public candidate is the C# static Site with no runtime JavaScript; the Worker stays the thin TypeScript adapter (worker/index.ts), emitted by Node type stripping. Node remains build and deploy tooling for wrangler only. The candidate job enforces the Blazor profile budgets and seals the Site; the deploy job ships the same sealed bytes under the unchanged main-push guards. No hosted browser, device, macOS or live-service check is added.
review.maintenance: The npm closure is pinned exactly and admitted by this receipt; any change needs a successor receipt that names this file. The Contracts identity is the NuGet publication record eng/contracts/ArcForges.Contracts.PublicApi/1.0.0-ci.287.1, bound by eng/version-sources.json and Directory.Packages.props; any change needs a successor record. Published Contracts npm versions stay immutable on the registry and Web no longer consumes them. Historical receipts stay immutable.
review.immutableHistory: Admitted review records are retained in Git history. A dependency change requires a new reviewed source commit and updated input-bound rationale; never amend an already accepted provenance record.
